Class Vector3

java.lang.Object
Vector3
public class Vector3 extends Object
A utility class that represents a three-dimensional vector value, with an x-, y-, and z-component. Vector3 objects are immutable, meaning that a new object must be created to change the value of the vector.

      public static Vector3 createPolar(float theta, float phi, float length)
      Creates a new Vector3 from the specified spherical polar coordinates.
      Parameters:
      theta - The azimuthal (xy plane) angle in radians from the positive x-axis to the positive y-axis
      phi - The polar angle in radians from the positive z-axis to the xy-plane
      length - The length or magnitude of the vector
      Returns:

    • withX

      public Vector3 withX(float x)
      Creates a new Vector3 object with the specified x-component and the same y- and z-components as the original vector. This is useful for "setting" the x-component of the vector, since Vector3 objects are immutable.
      Parameters:
      x - The new x-component of the vector
      Returns:
      The new vector with the specified x-component

    • lengthSq

      public float lengthSq()
      Calculates the square of the length of the vector, equal to the dot product of the vector with itself. This method should be used in favor of length() when making length comparisons, due to its faster time complexity.
      Returns:
      The square of the length of the vector

    • length

      public float length()
      Calculates the length of the vector. lengthSq() should be used instead of this method when making length comparisons due to its faster time complexity.
      Returns:
      The length of the vector
